name: Dreamfolks Services Ltd
title: Dreamfolks Services Ltd - 543591 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue collapsed to INR 660.6 cr from 1,291.9 cr as domestic lounge model reset; Q4 gross profit negative INR 6.1 cr and no quantified FY27 guidance, breakeven pushed out a year.

triggers.label: Revenue halved FY26 INR 660.6 cr
triggers.quote: the decline primarily caused due to the structural reset in our domestic lounge business

triggers.label: Q4 gross profit negative INR 6.1 cr
triggers.quote: For Q4 FY26, we reported revenue of INR 52.6 crores, with Gross Profit at negative INR 6.1 crores.

triggers.label: Breakeven pushed to a year later
triggers.quote: we would start seeing the breakeven maybe a year later

triggers.label: Receivables ~INR130 cr being collected
triggers.quote: we have done significant collections and that number currently stands reduced to a large extent

triggers.label: Global lounge volume +140% YoY
triggers.quote: Transaction volumes from our global lounge program have exhibited a strong growth of 140% year-on-year

guidance.quote: our plan of INR500 crores 5 years remains clear intact

guidance.value: about a year later than FY27
guidance.quote: we would start seeing the breakeven maybe a year later
